repo_notes.content: Canonical DeepWiki URL: https://deepwiki.com/igor53627/plinko-rs (GitHub repo igor53627/plinko-rs). The old plinko-extractor slug is retired after the repository rename.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: This repository implements the Plinko PIR (Private Information Retrieval) scheme from ePrint 2024-318. The canonical protocol reference is docs/plinko_paper_index.json (parsed paper parts, mainnet v3 reference counts). On-disk layout: docs/data_format.md. Test data: local Reth extract or gen_synthetic.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Public snapshot HTTP hosts and Cloudflare R2 regression buckets are retired. Use ./target/release/plinko --limit for subsets, or gen_synthetic for Modal/GPU benches. Mainnet reference counts: docs/data_format.md and plinko_paper_index.json mainnet_v3_snapshot.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: The plinko/ crate contains the core Plinko implementation: iPRF (invertible PRF), IprfTee, Sometimes-Recurse PRP (SwapOrNotSr), integer-only Binomial(count, 1/2) PMNS sampling (coin_binomial / coin_binomial_ct: bit count of an AES-128 counter keystream per tree node; the iPRF range w must be a power of two), and hint generation. The canonical Rocq specs/proofs and linking layer live in plinko/formal/ (see .github/workflows/formal.yml).
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Constant-time HintInit (plinko_hints --constant-time, tee build feature, experimental, not part of the trust model): hint_init::hint_cutoffs_ct (subsets::find_cutoff_ct, a bit-by-bit search) and hint_init::fill_parities_ct (IprfTeeTable::inverse_ct with MAX_PREIMAGES=512 fixed slots, SwapOrNotSrTee::inverse_many_ct over every round of every stage, one AES-128 select value compared with the 32-bit cutoff, masked XOR into the parity accumulators). Claim: on one thread the sequence of operations depends only on public values. Not hidden: the memory accesses at the secret hint index, which give the iPRF mapping to an observer of pages or cache lines, and the cache-dependent time of these accesses (docs/constant_time_mode.md). PRP round keys have no division (reduce_below in plinko/src/iprf.rs).
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Hint file: plinko_hints --output writes all hints of one client to one file (plinko::hints::HintSet; magic PLNKHINT, version 4, record size, geometry, hint counts, seed check, database version of the parities, version and BLAKE3 hash of the database that HintInit read, regular records of 4 + r bytes and backup records of 4 + 2r bytes for a record size r, BLAKE3 checksum; layout in docs/data_format.md). The record size is a parameter: plinko_hints --record-size (default 40, the v3 record), ProtocolParams::record_size. A parity is the XOR of whole records. The file does not contain the master seed (--seed-file); Client::from_hints loads it and rejects another record size, geometry, hint count or seed.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Key video resource: Alex Hoover's talk 'Plinko - Single-Server PIR with Efficient Updates via Invertible PRFs' at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okJaBn7ZXnc
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: The PRP uses Morris-Rogaway Sometimes-Recurse (SR) wrapper for full-domain security. Round counts follow paper-faithful formula: t_N = ceil(7.23 lg N + 4.82 lambda + 4.82 lg p) from Morris-Rogaway 2013/560 Section 5. Default is 128-bit security.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Formal models (plinko/formal): the Rocq proofs are about hand-written models, not about the Rust code. Proven for the models: PRP bijection (Swap-or-Not, Sometimes-Recurse), iPRF inverse and partition for all coins, streaming parity equals batch parity for regular hints. One Admitted: hint_init_backup_streaming_eq_batch in HintInitSim.v. plinko/formal/docs/TRUST_BASE.md is generated by scripts/trust_base.py and lists each Axiom, Parameter and Admitted with its meaning and the known differences from the code; make verify-axioms fails when it is out of date. docs/Plinko.v is a sketch.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: The plinko crate now includes a cost-estimation CLI binary (`cost_estimate`) for preflight capacity/cost planning. CI smoke-tests it in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and usage is documented in `README.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Scope (owner decision, 2026-11-17, backlog/decisions/decision-1): the target is a PIR library for a database of fixed-size records. The full Ethereum state is not a target, because each client must download the database (73.4 GB at mainnet) and run HintInit (about 300 core-hours, extrapolated). The Reth extractor and the mainnet numbers are test data and a scale reference. Measured costs of the current code are in docs/protocol_overview.md; tee-test/SEV-SNP-BENCHMARK.md, docs/BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md and docs/gpu_benchmark_commands.md are historical.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Online protocol (plinko/src/protocol.rs, docs/online_protocol.md): prepare_query reserves the hint and one backup hint; the hint leaves the client in reconstruct_and_replenish or abandon_query. The decoy for a cached index is a uniform index that is not cached and not in flight. The query format with c/2 shared offsets is from keewoolee/rms24-plinko-spec, not from RMS24 or the Plinko paper; the document gives an argument for it, not a proof.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Database versions and deltas (plinko/src/delta.rs, docs/update_strategy.md): the publisher numbers each database state. plinko_hints --database-version stores the version in the hint file. Response::database_version carries the version of an answer; Client::reconstruct_and_replenish accepts only the version of the hints and leaves the query in flight on a mismatch. Delta (magic PLNKDLTA, format version 1: record size, num_entries, from_version, to_version, changes of index and old XOR new, BLAKE3 checksum) is written by Server::apply_updates; Client::apply_delta accepts only a delta that starts at the version of the hints, so a repeated or early delta changes nothing. The number of records is fixed for a hint set. Not implemented: a delta producer for files, transport, and authentication of a delta or an answer. Client::unused_hints is None after the first query, and a reload of the hint file after queries reuses hints; a client that sent queries starts again from a state file (Client::write_state, Client::read_state).

Client state file (plinko/src/protocol/state.rs, docs/online_protocol.md section Client State And Restart, docs/data_format.md): a hint file holds the hints of a client that sent no query. Client::write_state writes the state after queries (magic PLNKSTAT, format version 1: hint set, bitmap of sent regular hints, answered queries with promoted backup hint and record, queries in flight, retired backup hints, BLAKE3 checksum); Client::read_state builds a client from it and returns the queries in flight with the same message bytes. The caller must record each query before it leaves the client (a state, or a log of PreparedQuery::hint_index for Client::retire_hints), must use a new query seed for each start, and must keep the file secret (it holds queried indices and records). The format cannot detect a state that is older than the last query.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: Integrity (docs/integrity.md): the library gives no integrity of an answer or of a delta; this is a decision. The client checks the database version label of an answer and of a delta and the file checksums; it must trust the parities and the changes. The hint file stores the BLAKE3 hash of the database that HintInit read (HintSet::init_database); a delta does not update it. A wrong answer gives a wrong record with no error, and the error spreads through the promoted backup hint; the messages of the client do not depend on the bytes of an answer. An application that needs integrity puts an authenticator of the publisher in each record and must not show the result of its check to the server.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

pages.title: Plinko Protocol
pages.purpose: Document the Plinko PIR scheme from paper 2024-318: HintInit, Query, Answer, Recon, UpdateHint algorithms

pages.title: iPRF Implementation
pages.purpose: Document plinko/src/iprf.rs and related modules: Sometimes-Recurse PRP (SwapOrNotSr), PMNS (Pseudorandom Multinomial Sampler), integer-only Binomial(count, 1/2) sampling (coin_binomial and constant-time coin_binomial_ct), Iprf vs IprfTee, and constant-time primitives in plinko/src/constant_time.rs for TEE execution.

pages.title: Hint Generation
pages.purpose: Document plinko/src/bin/plinko_hints.rs: streaming HintInit, regular/backup hints, block subsets stored as one 32-bit PRF cutoff per hint (plinko::subsets), constant-time mode (--constant-time, tee feature) with ct_lt_u64, ct_select_usize and masked XOR

pages.title: Ethereum State Extractor
pages.purpose: Document src/: Reth database extraction, account/storage mapping, output artifacts (database.bin, mappings). State that the extractor is a source of large test data; the full Ethereum state is not a target of the repository.

pages.title: Formal Verification
pages.purpose: Document plinko/formal/: Rocq models (SwapOrNotSpec, SwapOrNotSrSpec, IprfSpec, BinomialSpec as the coin sampler), proofs about the models (SwapOrNotProofs, IprfProofs), the generated trust base (docs/TRUST_BASE.md, scripts/trust_base.py), CI workflow. State that the Rust code is not formally verified and that the linking files are placeholders.
